title: [OBJ-02] Create the Scorecard Catalogue Objects
description: Plan task ID: OBJ-02 Objective: Establish the inherited catalogue family required by all governed scorecard selections. Detailed scope: Create non-instantiable `Supplier Scorecard Abstract Catalog Record` and its twelve direct children: Supplier Commodity, NAICS Classification, KPI Category, KPI Aggregation Method, KPI Value Type, KPI Contribution Source, KPI Collection Method, KPI Initialization Method, Safety Benchmark Metric, Scorecard Cadence, KPI Value Origin, and Publication Exception Treatment. Deliverable: Abstract catalogue parent and twelve correctly inherited concrete child objects. Strict technical prerequisites: APP-01 Blocked status: Blocked until APP-01 is complete. Recommended implementer: Senior Associate Consultant Recommended reviewer/approver: Senior Consultant Role rationale: The object work is routine, but inheritance and non-instantiable behavior require independent configuration judgment. Acceptance criteria: Exactly twelve direct children inherit from the abstract parent; the parent cannot be instantiated or selected; no multiple parent or cycle exists. Specification references: Sections 4.2, 5, 7, 21.1 Assumptions and open questions: None.

title: [IMP-07] Configure Next Generation Delay Creation

• Reject an existing Delay for the Program/reporting-period key and an existing or concurrent Run for the Scheduled Generation Date.
• Create all protected cycle fields together, then open the record for required Delay Until and Reason entry.
